name: Underbelly
menu_notes: Source: web search cross-checks against Yelp's item pages and reviews (Toast ordering page at order.toasttab.com/online/ubnp 403'd on fetch). Underbelly, Belly of the Beast, Tonkotsu, Chicken Confit (description 'corn, spicy miso, garlic butter' matches verbatim) and Thai Curry ('lobster red curry broth' matches verbatim) all confirmed as real current dishes. Yelp's own crowdsourced menu page lists noticeably lower prices ($8-12) for some of these, but that page also omits Farmer's Market/Thai Curry/Chicken Confit entirely, suggesting the Yelp menu itself is the stale one -- our Toast-sourced $13-15 range is more consistent with 2026 San Diego ramen pricing.
data_notes: Address (3000 Upas St, North Park) and hours (11:30am-11:30pm daily) both confirmed exactly. Cuisine label (Japanese/Ramen) correct.
